details.ingredients: Dairy Whitener, Maltitol (INS 965(i)), Sugar, Instant Tea Powder (9%), Potato Starch, Spice Mix (2%), Beetroot Juice Powder, Non-Caloric Sweetener (INS 960).

title: Taj Mahal Tea House 2nd Flush Orthodox Chai

details.description:
The Darjeeling Second Flush Tea is meant for those who appreciate the innate, fine strength of Darjeeling black tea. This tea flush comes with a sweet touch of muscatel that truly is a connoisseur’s delight.
Product Information:
Darjeeling Second Flush Tea yields its finest quality after spring. Carefully handpicked during the months of May and June, the tea leaves of the Second Flush have beautiful purplish blooms.
In contrast to the First Flush, this yield retains a darker amber hue and a stronger, fuller body, but with a smoother finish.
Savoured worldwide as one of the best Darjeeling teas, it boasts a unique, sweet, and fruity muscatel grape flavour.
This is a second harvest seasonal, smooth & strong cup of tea, best enjoyed without milk. The unique Muscatel flavour is a 'prized find' for the Darjeeling Tea planter during the May-June period each year.
Appearance: Amber hue; more intensity and colour than the First Flush variant.
Taste Note: Mature, fruity, full-bodied, and wine-like, owing to the muscatel flavour.
It is an ideal tea for everyday drinking as well as for gifting on special occasions such as Ganpati, Raksha Bandhan, Diwali, birthdays, anniversaries, and housewarming.
details.storageInstructions: Please store the tea in a dry airtight container in cool, dry place after opening the pack.
details.usageInstructions: Prepare it in the way you make your clear tea. No need to add any other ingredients.
